title: Hyper-V Performance - Host

panels.description: Virtual machines running on the host right now (newest sample).

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT r.CounterName AS c, p.DateTime AS t, p.SampleValue AS v
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE p.DateTime >= DATEADD(day, -3, GETUTCDATE()) AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '')
    AND r.ObjectName IN ('Community Hyper-V Host Capacity', 'Community Hyper-V Host CPU', 'Community Hyper-V Host Memory')
    AND r.CounterName IN ('Running VM Count', 'Total VM Count', 'Virtual Processor to Logical Processor Ratio', 'Hypervisor Total Run Time %', 'Physical Memory Utilisation %', 'Available Memory MB')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.CounterName, p.DateTime, p.AverageValue
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE p.DateTime >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETUTCDATE()) AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '')
    AND r.ObjectName IN ('Community Hyper-V Host Capacity', 'Community Hyper-V Host CPU', 'Community Hyper-V Host Memory')
    AND r.CounterName IN ('Running VM Count', 'Total VM Count', 'Virtual Processor to Logical Processor Ratio', 'Hypervisor Total Run Time %', 'Physical Memory Utilisation %', 'Available Memory MB')
),
l AS (SELECT c, v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c ORDER BY t DESC) AS rn FROM s)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Running VM Count' THEN v END) AS "Running VMs",
       MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Total VM Count' THEN v END) AS "Total VMs",
       MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Virtual Processor to Logical Processor Ratio' THEN v END) AS "vCPU to CPU ratio",
       MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Hypervisor Total Run Time %' THEN v END) AS "CPU busy %",
       MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Physical Memory Utilisation %' THEN v END) AS "Memory used %",
       MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Available Memory MB' THEN v END) AS "Memory free MB"
FROM l WHERE rn = 1

panels.title: Memory free

panels.description: Average across the host's logical processors. Guests = time running virtual machines, hypervisor overhead = time in the hypervisor itself, host operating system = the management OS.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time, CASE r.CounterName WHEN 'Hypervisor Total Run Time %' THEN 'All processors busy' WHEN 'Hypervisor Guest Run Time %' THEN 'Running guests' WHEN 'Hypervisor Hypervisor Run Time %' THEN 'Hypervisor overhead' WHEN 'Root Partition Total Run Time %' THEN 'Host operating system' ELSE r.CounterName END AS metric, AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'Community Hyper-V Host CPU' AND r.CounterName IN ('Hypervisor Total Run Time %', 'Hypervisor Guest Run Time %', 'Hypervisor Hypervisor Run Time %', 'Root Partition Total Run Time %')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '')
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), CASE r.CounterName WHEN 'Hypervisor Total Run Time %' THEN 'All processors busy' WHEN 'Hypervisor Guest Run Time %' THEN 'Running guests' WHEN 'Hypervisor Hypervisor Run Time %' THEN 'Hypervisor overhead' WHEN 'Root Partition Total Run Time %' THEN 'Host operating system' ELSE r.CounterName END
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime, CASE r.CounterName WHEN 'Hypervisor Total Run Time %' THEN 'All processors busy' WHEN 'Hypervisor Guest Run Time %' THEN 'Running guests' WHEN 'Hypervisor Hypervisor Run Time %' THEN 'Hypervisor overhead' WHEN 'Root Partition Total Run Time %' THEN 'Host operating system' ELSE r.CounterName END, AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'Community Hyper-V Host CPU' AND r.CounterName IN ('Hypervisor Total Run Time %', 'Hypervisor Guest Run Time %', 'Hypervisor Hypervisor Run Time %', 'Root Partition Total Run Time %')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '')
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, CASE r.CounterName WHEN 'Hypervisor Total Run Time %' THEN 'All processors busy' WHEN 'Hypervisor Guest Run Time %' THEN 'Running guests' WHEN 'Hypervisor Hypervisor Run Time %' THEN 'Hypervisor overhead' WHEN 'Root Partition Total Run Time %' THEN 'Host operating system' ELSE r.CounterName END
) x ORDER BY time

panels.title: CPU: where the time goes

panels.description: A busy processor next to idle ones means one workload is pinned to a few cores. The gap between the busiest and least busy lines shows how evenly the load is spread.

  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId

    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '')
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), CASE r.CounterName WHEN 'Busiest Logical Processor Run Time %' THEN 'Busiest logical processor' WHEN 'Least Busy Logical Processor Run Time %' THEN 'Least busy logical processor' WHEN 'Logical Processor Idle Time %' THEN 'Idle (average)' ELSE r.CounterName END
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime, CASE r.CounterName WHEN 'Busiest Logical Processor Run Time %' THEN 'Busiest logical processor' WHEN 'Least Busy Logical Processor Run Time %' THEN 'Least busy logical processor' WHEN 'Logical Processor Idle Time %' THEN 'Idle (average)' ELSE r.CounterName END, AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId

    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: CPU balance across logical processors

panels.description: How long virtual processors wait to be scheduled onto a real processor each time. Rising values mean VMs are queueing for CPU (over-commitment). Shown in nanoseconds as Microsoft documents the counter; the unit is not independently verified.

  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time, CASE r.CounterName WHEN 'Guest VP CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch (average)' THEN 'Average wait' WHEN 'Guest VP CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch (peak)' THEN 'Longest wait' ELSE r.CounterName END AS metric, AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId

  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId

    AND r.ObjectName = 'Community Hyper-V Host CPU' AND r.CounterName IN ('Guest VP CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch (average)', 'Guest VP CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch (peak)')
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '')
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), CASE r.CounterName WHEN 'Guest VP CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch (average)' THEN 'Average wait' WHEN 'Guest VP CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch (peak)' THEN 'Longest wait' ELSE r.CounterName END
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime, CASE r.CounterName WHEN 'Guest VP CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch (average)' THEN 'Average wait' WHEN 'Guest VP CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch (peak)' THEN 'Longest wait' ELSE r.CounterName END, AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId

panels.description: Link speed, utilisation, throughput and the highest error and discard counts seen in the time range. Error and discard counts are totals since the adapter started, so a rising value matters more than a high one.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS host, i.InstanceName AS nic, r.CounterName AS c, p.DateTime AS t, p.SampleValue AS v
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880 AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND r.ObjectName IN ('Community Hyper-V Host Network', 'Community Hyper-V Host Network Capacity')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName, r.CounterName, p.DateTime, p.AverageValue
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND r.ObjectName IN ('Community Hyper-V Host Network', 'Community Hyper-V Host Network Capacity')
)
SELECT host AS Host, nic AS Adapter,
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Link Speed bits per sec' THEN v END) / 1000000000.0, 2) AS "Link Gbit/s",
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c = 'Network Utilisation %' THEN v END), 2) AS "Avg utilisation %",
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Network Utilisation %' THEN v END), 2) AS "Max utilisation %",
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c = 'Bytes Received per sec' THEN v END) / 1048576.0, 3) AS "Avg received MB/s",
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c = 'Bytes Sent per sec' THEN v END) / 1048576.0, 3) AS "Avg sent MB/s",
       MAX(CASE WHEN c IN ('Packets Received Errors Total', 'Packets Outbound Errors Total') THEN v END) AS "Errors seen",
       MAX(CASE WHEN c IN ('Packets Received Discarded Total', 'Packets Outbound Discarded Total') THEN v END) AS "Discards seen"
FROM s GROUP BY host, nic ORDER BY host, nic

panels.description: Newest size and free space of each volume the management pack collects. Status is critical under 10 percent free and a warning under 20 percent.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS host, i.InstanceName AS vol, r.CounterName AS c, p.DateTime AS t, p.SampleValue AS v
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p

  WHERE p.DateTime >= DATEADD(day, -3, GETUTCDATE()) AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND r.ObjectName = 'Community Hyper-V Host Volume Capacity'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT h.DisplayName, i.InstanceName, r.CounterName, p.DateTime, p.AverageValue
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE p.DateTime >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETUTCDATE()) AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote}) AND r.ObjectName = 'Community Hyper-V Host Volume Capacity'
),
l AS (SELECT host, vol, c, v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY host, vol, c ORDER BY t DESC) AS rn FROM s),
w AS (
  SELECT host, vol,
         MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Volume Size MB' THEN v END) AS sz, MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Volume Free MB' THEN v END) AS fr, MAX(CASE WHEN c = 'Volume Free %' THEN v END) AS frp
  FROM l WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY host, vol
)
SELECT host AS Host, vol AS Volume, ROUND(sz / 1024.0, 1) AS "Size GB", ROUND(fr / 1024.0, 1) AS "Free GB", ROUND(frp, 1) AS "Free %",
       CASE WHEN frp < 10 THEN 'Critical: under 10% free' WHEN frp < 20 THEN 'Warning: under 20% free' ELSE 'OK' END AS Status
FROM w ORDER BY frp
